expected_outcomes: Dependencies are justified, maintained, reviewable, and removable.
required_actions: Prefer maintained packages, pin versions, review material upgrades, test changes, and remove unused dependencies.
expected_documents: Dependency lock and material upgrade record.
acceptance: Automated dependency changes receive the same review and test gates as manual changes.
verification: Inspect locks and run applicable compatibility and dependency checks.
evidence: Dependency diff, changelog review, and test output.
failure_conditions: Unpinned, unused, abandoned, or unreviewed dependencies enter production paths.
exceptions: Record owner, duration, maintenance risk, and removal plan.
